name: Arrest
overview: Scripture records multiple instances of arrest involving key figures in the early Christian narrative. Jesus was taken by force and bound as He was led to the high priest, demonstrating the opposition He faced from religious authorities (Matthew 26:57; Mark 14:46; Luke 22:54; John 18:12). Similarly, the apostles were seized and imprisoned by the Sadducees out of envy and indignation, showing the ongoing persecution of Christ's followers (Acts 5:17-18). The topic also includes arrests of Paul and Silas, as well as Paul’s authorized role in arresting Christians, highlighting the tension between the gospel and established powers during the early church era.
